Her spokesperson, Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., called the NBI findings a “shameless smear campaign” and questioned Director Melvin Matibag's decision to publicize them.

stories.title: The fight to switch off your algorithm – podcast
stories.summary: Campaigner Chanel Contos discusses her effort to curb social-media algorithms and its role in shaping an Australian bill aimed at stronger regulation of big technology companies. The Guardian podcast also traces her earlier work through Teach Us Consent, which successfully campaigned for consent education to be mandated in Australia's national curriculum.

stories.title: Online ads weaponised to deliver ‘zero-click’ spyware, researchers say
stories.summary: Citizen Lab researchers at the University of Toronto say millions of online advertisements have been used to enable “zero-click” spyware attacks. They allege that Controlium software from Israeli advertising agency Discover-Tech lets clients profile internet users at scale and then covertly hack selected targets.

stories.title: Tool and target: US law enforcement grapple with AI-enabled terrorism and anti-tech extremism
stories.summary: US law-enforcement agencies, from the FBI to local police, are increasingly warning about both would-be terrorists using AI chatbots to plan attacks and extremists targeting AI technology. The Guardian links those concerns to a May 2025 car bombing outside a Palm Springs fertility clinic that killed the 25-year-old attacker and injured four other people.
